semantic_extortion_policy_v2.description: Bounded sender-attributed threat + recipient-directed payment + conditional consequence policy. Missing policy or unresolved attribution is an explicit inspection gap; mere words never supply threat authority.

semantic_nlp_authority_policy_v2.description: NLP corroboration authority requires a typed current-recipient secret-return instruction to an explicit sender-return target in the same clause. Generic login, prose style, or NLP output cannot supply their own authority.

semantic_secret_return_policy_v1.description: Direct login-secret disclosure in Chinese, English and mixed text. Requires an original current recipient action and explicit return destination or typed secret question; not a generic login request.

semantic_verification_transfer_policy_v1.description: Refundable funds verification in Chinese, English or mixed text: current transfer request, substantial or whole-balance amount, local validation/freeze purpose and explicit refund promise. All witnesses share an attributed bounded source block.

semantic_funds_release_fee_policy_v1.description: Advance fee requested to release the recipient's own funds, balance, proceeds or loan. Requires an original current payment action with a fee object and locally attributed asset plus payment-dependent release; invoices, ordinary purchases and fee mentions alone never qualify.

semantic_workflow_policy_v1.description: Bounded attributed workflow graphs: fabricated kinship contradicting known heir eligibility or arbitrary charitable-recipient selection, tied to an estate financial benefit and current cooperation; remote collection of an existing withdrawal PIN jointly with identity or OTP material. Role words, percentages, urgency and authority alone never score.

semantic_combination_risk_policy_v1.description: CPU-only bounded graded semantic risk: operation/argument/purpose combinations, distinct from legacy complete attack proofs. Neither urgency, authority nor generic scenarios independently score. Explicit normal transaction/debt/micro-verification and source-attribution controls remain.
